title: Tensor comparison for an invertible change of ring sheaf
statement: Let $U,V$ be schemes, $f:U\to V$, $R_V,R_U$ commutative ring sheaves on their small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], $L_r$ any ring-sheaf functor from $V$ to $U$, and $c:L_r(R_V)\cong R_U$. Let $L_0$ and $L_M$ be functors from $R_V$-module sheaves to $L_r(R_V)$-module sheaves and $R_U$-module sheaves respectively [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Suppose $t:L_M\operatorname{res}_c\cong L_0$, where $\operatorname{res}_c$ is pushforward along the identity site functor with ring map $c$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Then there are isomorphisms $d_G:R_U\otimes_{L_r(R_V)}L_0G\cong L_MG$, with tensor change of rings defined by sheafifying the sectionwise tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. For every $h:G\to H$, $\operatorname{changeOfRings}(L_0h)d_H=d_GL_Mh$. For every site object $W$, $a\in R_U(W)$, $m\in (L_0G)(W)$, $d_G(\eta_W(a\otimes m))=t_G^{-1}(c_W^{-1}(a)m)$, where $\eta$ is the sheafification unit.

proof.text: At each object W apply Mathlib ModuleCat.ExtendRestrictScalarsAdj.HomEquiv.fromExtendScalars to e.hom(W), where e is t(G) inverse. Its value on a tensor a tensor m is a times e.hom(W)(m). The ring isomorphism c(W) makes restriction of scalars an equivalence (ModuleCat.restrictScalars_isEquivalence_of_ringEquiv). The transpose is extendScalars(e.hom(W)) followed by the adjunction counit; both factors are isomorphisms, so this section map is invertible. Equality with the transpose is checked on 1 tensor m using extendRestrictScalarsAdj_homEquiv_apply.

The section maps commute with restrictions: apply ExtendScalars.hom_ext, use exists_changeOfRingsMap on 1 tensor m and naturality_apply for e.hom. PresheafOfModules.isoMk bundles them. Sheafify this presheaf isomorphism and compose with the invertible sheafification counit. The hom-equivalence naturality and counit identity show that its composite with toSheafify is the original section map. Linearity of t.inv and c.hom(c.inv(a))=a convert a times t.inv(m) into the required t.inv(c.inv(a) times m).

For a module map h define the sectionwise tensor map psi using extendScalars.map. The equation psi followed by the comparison for H equals the comparison for G followed by LM(h) is checked with ExtendScalars.hom_ext on 1 tensor m, ExtendScalars.map_tmul and t.inv.naturality. Apply the sheafification functor and its counit naturality to obtain the required naturality equation.
